bullets.text: AI Dominates Super Bowl Ads - AI is set to steal the spotlight in Super Bowl LX commercials, including Anthropic's jab at competitors.
NFL Sunday Ticket Available Early - YouTube TV allows fans to purchase NFL Sunday Ticket for the 2026 season ahead of Super Bowl.
Spotify Sells Physical Books - Spotify expands its offerings by allowing UK and US premium subscribers to buy physical books.
iOS 26 Enhances Phone App - The new iOS 26 Phone app features a call screening option that improves spam filtering.
SteelSeries Launches Premium Headphones - The Arctis Nova Elite headphones offer high-res audio and innovative battery design for gamers.
Spotify Introduces 'Page Match' - New feature lets users pick up audiobooks where they left off using a photo of their book.
Tim Cook Highlights Visual Intelligence - Apple's visual intelligence feature is gaining popularity and may see further enhancements soon.
Telegram's Major Redesign - Telegram for Android adopts a Liquid Glass design, enhancing user experience with a fresh UI.
AT&T Launches Kid-Friendly Phone - The AmiGo Jr. Phone features parental controls and is designed for children's safe usage.
Cerebras Secures $1 Billion Funding - AI chipmaker Cerebras Systems raises significant capital, enhancing its position in the tech landscape.
